text:
Morgan: Kicking off preflight for the phased waveband rollout. Target change window tonight 00:30-02:00 UTC. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, canary then 10% slices. Need quick capacity checks and any regional hotfix pins. @deploy-bot kick off canary smoke when ready
deploy-bot: Deploy bot starting canary job
deploy-bot: Canary group: service=runtime, version=v2.4.0-canary, slice=us-east-1, expected ramp=5%
Sara: US warm pool health: 88% nodes warm, sustained cpu headroom ~22%. Ready for canary at 5% 
Kevin: EU overview: eu-west2 warm pool at ~66%. We have 8 spare nodes if we shift burst quota, but that eats into backfill cushion. APAC is the concern.
Anjali: APAC status: apac-sg and apac-tok are cold. Warmup ETA for 10 nodes ~28m. Network priming still 40% done. I'd prefer delaying APAC canary until warm nodes are up.
Leo: Quick perf probe from staging sim @ 200 rps for 10s: p95=120ms, p99=320ms. No OOMs.
deploy-bot: Smoke test output:
```
[smoke] 10s sustained @200 rps
p50=24ms p95=118ms p99=318ms
errors=0/2000
kv-cache hit=94%
```
ops-oncall: Noted a minor db failover in eu-west1 earlier — resolved, but keep an eye on rtt spikes for first 20m post-canary.
Morgan: Decision proposal: start US canary now, hold EU at warm pool 70% (we're close), delay APAC by 30m and pre-warm extra 6 nodes. Rollback triggers: error-rate >1% for 5m or p95 spike >250ms above baseline. Thoughts?
Sara: +1 on US canary now. I'll increase reserve to push EU to ~72% in 10m.
Kevin: Agree. Add an automatic pin for EU after canary passes (pin to v2.4.0-canary for first 30m) so we can A/B roll safely.
Anjali: I'll execute warmup for APAC and monitor. If warmup doesn't hit target in 25m we abort APAC and backfill with US capacity.
deploy-bot: Canary started in us-east-1 at 4123456795. Monitoring hooks active.
deploy-bot: Canary health: 60s snapshot -> error-rate=0.2%, p95 delta=+12ms, queue depth stable
Morgan: Good. Ops, add the runbook snippet for emergency rollback and the command for the on-call to use if thresholds breach.
ops-oncall: Rollback quick command:
```
deploybot rollback --service runtime --version previous-stable --region apac --force
# or to pin previous globally
deploybot pin --service runtime --version previous-stable --scope global
```
Kevin: Also set metric alert: if 5m error-rate >1% OR 3m user-latency p95 increase >200ms -> auto-hold new slices and notify #incidents.
Sara: I'll relay to capacity team to hold a 2-node cold cushion in APAC in case we need immediate backfill.
Morgan: Final: US canary proceeds. EU to follow after we confirm warm pool >=72% and 15m stable metrics. APAC delayed 30m for pre-warm; if not warmed abort APAC and re-route traffic. Rolling timebox noted in release notes. :thumbsup:
Anjali: Will update the runbook and post the change-window note in the release doc.
deploy-bot: Canary status at 4123456840 -> stable. No rollback.
Morgan: Thanks all — keep this thread for live signal updates. If anyone sees >:warning: escalate in #incidents and ping @ops-oncall.
